delivery.title: Register the miner hotkey on SN21 (finney netuid 21)
delivery.note: Burns TAO and needs the coldkey password. Upstream docs also ask for a one-time ed25519 binding (scripts/sn21_keys.py generate, then register) from an upstream clone; that binding is a separate signed commit. One seat per coldkey is paid.

delivery.title: Train on the newest published bundle and keep the evaluate result
delivery.command: python3 tracks/main/train.py --data "$SN21_TRAINING_DATA" --holdout 0.2 && python3 tracks/main/evaluate.py --data "$SN21_TRAINING_DATA" && python3 tracks/main/train.py --data "$SN21_TRAINING_DATA" --holdout 0
delivery.note: Download the bundle yourself (61 MB, not committed). Ship only if evaluate reports deterministic true, coverage 1.0, gate_admitted_estimate true and score above reference_v2; the last command refits on all data for the image.

delivery.title: Build the image and push it to a PRIVATE registry repository
delivery.command: docker build -t "$SN21_IMAGE_REPO:candidate" tracks/main && docker push "$SN21_IMAGE_REPO:candidate" && docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' "$SN21_IMAGE_REPO:candidate"
delivery.note: Keep the repository private until the commitment lands: the digest is content-addressed, and the earliest on-chain commit of a digest is the one paid.

delivery.title: Run the image in the subnet's sandbox flags three times and compare outputs
delivery.command: for i in 1 2 3; do docker run --rm -i --network=none --memory=1g --memory-swap=1g --cpus=1 --pids-limit=256 --read-only --security-opt=no-new-privileges "$SN21_IMAGE_REPO@sha256:<64hex>" < basket.jsonl > run$i.jsonl; done; cmp run1.jsonl run2.jsonl && cmp run2.jsonl run3.jsonl && echo deterministic
delivery.note: basket.jsonl: about 250 served episodes, e.g. the input field of held-out training v4 records. Must finish well under 15 CPU minutes and 1 GB.

delivery.title: Commit the image digest on chain
delivery.command: python3 -c "import bittensor as bt,os; s=bt.Subtensor(network='finney'); w=bt.Wallet(name=os.environ['BT_WALLET_NAME'], hotkey=os.environ['BT_WALLET_HOTKEY']); print(s.commit(wallet=w, netuid=21, data='sn21-model:v1:<repo>@sha256:<64hex>'))"
delivery.note: Repo lowercase with no tag; whole string about 128 bytes at most. The commitment slot is last-write-wins. A new digest re-enters the admission gate and starts a previous-model discount on older entries. The call is the one upstream's quickstart documents; newer bittensor releases may expose it as set_commitment.

delivery.title: Make the image repository public and check an anonymous pull
delivery.note: Only after the commitment is visible on chain. A private image fails intake and is retried; it is never admitted.

delivery.title: Hold the published alpha floor on the miner hotkey
delivery.note: From upstream docs/SN21_STAKING.md: a hotkey below the hold is not seated for pay that day. Staking spends funds and is a person's decision.

delivery.title: Watch the admission verdict, daily coverage and standing
delivery.note: Run verify_day.py from an upstream SN21-adtao clone. Gate verdicts are announced on Discord and adtao.io. Paid needs 250 evidence mass, 7 scored settle days and at least 75% daily coverage.

settings.name: SN21_IMAGE_REPO
settings.description: Lowercase registry repository for the miner image, without tag, e.g. ghcr.io/<you>/sn21-miner. Used by the image and commitment steps.

settings.name: SN21_TRAINING_DATA
settings.description: Path to a labelled corpus (training v4 .jsonl or .jsonl.gz, or v2/v3 .jsonl) for train.py and evaluate.py; the bundled weekly-era fixture is used when unset.
